title: Compute sedimentation profile and stacking sequence for test case 1
action: For the test case 1 parameters (mean aspect ratio, polydispersity, roundness, sample height, mean packing fraction) provided in the instruction, implement and run the iterative self-consistent solver to obtain equilibrium moment profiles, then compute orientational order parameters Q2(z), Q4(z) and local packing fraction η(z), and determine the stacking sequence. Output the results to case_1_results.json.
description: Sedimentation profile and stacking sequence for case 1 (parameters as in Figure 2, panels a1-d1).

title: Compute sedimentation profile, stacking sequence, and partial stacking diagram for test case 2
action: For the test case 2 parameters provided in the instruction, run the solver and compute order parameter profiles Q2(z), Q4(z), η(z), the stacking sequence, and additionally compute a grid of stacking sequences for a representative cut in (η, H) parameter space (list of {eta, H, stacking_sequence}). Output all results, including the grid under the key 'grid', to case_2_results.json.
description: Sedimentation profile and stacking sequence for case 2, plus a partial stacking diagram grid.

title: Compute sedimentation profile and stacking sequence for test case 3
action: For the test case 3 parameters provided in the instruction, run the solver and compute order parameter profiles Q2(z), Q4(z), η(z) and the stacking sequence. Output to case_3_results.json.
description: Sedimentation profile and stacking sequence for case 3 (parameters as in Figure 2, panels a3-d3).
